question: In which of the following states is India's first pollinator park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a bid to conserve pollinators, **India's first 'Pollinator Park' opened in Uttarakhand's Haldwani **(Nanital district) on 29 December 2020 and is** spread over 4 acres of land.**
 
• The park has been **developed by the Research Wing of Uttarakhand's Forest Department.**
 
• The Pollinator Park was** inaugurated by lepidopterist Peter Smetacek. **
 
• The park is home to around 40 different types of pollinator species which includes various species of honeybees, birds, and butterflies.
 
• **Uttarakhand**__
 __
 
• Capital: Dehradun (winter), Gairsain(summer)
 
• Chief Minister: Pushkar Singh Dhami
 
• Governor: Gurmit Singh
 
• National Park: Jim Corbett National Park, Nanda Devi National Park, Rajaji National Park, Valleys of Flowers National Park, Gangotri National Park
 
• State Animal: Alpine Musk Deer
 
• State Bird: Himalayan Monal
 
• State Tree: Buransh
 
• State Flower: Brahma Kamal
